meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器，执行打开网页、点击、填写表单、截图、提取数据等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要 Claude 帮你操作网页，比如填写表单、截图、测试网站或提取信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度，搜索“天气”并截图。
say.note: Claude 会依次执行打开、搜索、截图。

say.text: 登录我的邮箱，检查收件箱。
say.note: Claude 会导航到邮箱并填写登录信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser interactions: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract data from web pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to interact with websites, such as filling forms, taking screenshots, testing web apps, or extracting information.

say_en.text: Open Baidu, search for 'weather', and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate, search, and screenshot.

say_en.text: Log into my email and check the inbox.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate to the email site and fill in credentials.
